title: The Parking Sticker
intro: You park in town. The machine is "out of order", but a sticker offers a QR code to pay.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

screen.context: You scanned a sticker stuck on the parking machine. It looks stuck on top of the machine's own printed code.

time: Opened from a scanned QR code

msg.text: Enter your card number and PIN to pay.
The code was a sticker placed over the machine's own code.
The machine is out of order. Only pay here.

site.label: Not the parking company's site
site.lens: parkly-pay-now.top is not the real parking address on the machine's own printed code.
site.why: A scanned code can lead anywhere. Check the address it opens.

card.label: Asks for your card PIN
card.lens: Paying never needs your card PIN.
card.why: Anyone who asks for your PIN is a thief.

sticker.label: A sticker over the real code
sticker.lens: Someone stuck a new code on top of the machine's own.
sticker.why: A code stuck on top of another is a warning sign. Run your finger over it.

outoforder.label: "Out of order, only pay here"
outoforder.lens: It tells you to use only the sticker.
outoforder.why: A real machine does not send you to a sticker.

fee.label: A normal fee
fee.why: The price is normal. It proves nothing.

actions.label: Enter my card number and PIN
Pay in the parking company's own app, or at another machine

trap.title: Parkly Pay
trap.ask: Enter your card number and PIN to pay ₹50.

block_report.line: You reported the sticker to the parking company. They scraped it off and warned other drivers.

verify.line: The parking company's own app showed the bay and took your card safely. The sticker was fake. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The page copied your card and PIN. Money left your account within the hour.

what_if.go_ahead: Paying in the company's own app, or at another machine, would have been safe. No parking payment needs your PIN.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Check a QR code before you scan or pay: is it a sticker over another code? Pay in the real company's own app.

quick_check.q: A parking machine says it is out of order and shows a QR sticker that looks stuck on top. What do you do?

options.text: Scan it but skip the PIN
Pay in the company's own app or at another machine, and report the sticker

quick_check.explain: A sticker over a real code is the trick. Use the real company's own app.

hints.nudge: Look at how the code is stuck on.

rows.v: In the company's own app, or another machine
